name: Advanced Shortcodes
description: Adds a set of Bootstrap-style shortcode plugins (alerts, columns, rows, accordions, icon, jumbotron, progress, hr) to the Shortcode text-format filter.
project_description: Advanced Shortcodes complements the Shortcode module by shipping a set of ready-made Bootstrap-style shortcode plugins. Once the Shortcode text-format filter is enabled and the individual shortcodes are ticked on a text format, editors can wrap content in bracket tags such as [alerts], [accordions]/[accordion], [row]/[column], [icon], [jumbotron], [progress] and [hr] to output Bootstrap markup without writing HTML by hand. Each shortcode is a plugin under src/Plugin/Shortcode that builds a render array rendered by a Twig template in templates/. The module attaches its bundled Bootstrap CSS and an accordion accessibility script on all non-admin pages. It provides no routes, permissions, services or configuration of its own; it is configured entirely through the Shortcode filter settings on each text format.
